thread:
deploy-bot: HOLD — preflight mismatch: configmap/service-config differs between staging and prod. staging contains payment.timeout_ms=15000 and MIGRATION_LOCK=false; prod missing both. KMS alias mismatch: staging 'dev-kms-e1', prod 'kms-e1'. Blocking prod promotion.

maria (eng-release): ok, which PR added payment.timeout_ms?

lee (platform): PR 4951 (payments/retry-backoff) added the key last week. It was behind a toggle but the config key was merged.

anya (infra): KMS alias change was from my automation tests; I accidentally pushed a dev alias mapping to the shared terraform workspace. I can revert the alias entry.

ben (qa): concern: enabling MIGRATION_LOCK=false will run migrations at startup. If prod has never had the migrations, this could be risky. We need a clear migration job run plan and smoke checks.

carla (release): options: 1) patch prod config to match staging and proceed with canary; 2) pin image and skip the key; 3) move deploy to next window. Window closes in ~80m. Thoughts?

anya (infra): I can apply a minimal configmap patch (dry-run then apply) and roll out 10% canary for 10m. I'll also fix the KMS alias mapping immediately.

lee (platform): agree on canary. Abort if error rate >5% or migration jobs fail. Update release notes: include manual alias normalization and PR 4951. Add rollback steps: 1) patch configmap to previous state, 2) rollback image tag.

maria (eng-release): +1. Also create a post-release ticket to prevent terraform workspace leaks across envs.

ops-bot: kubectl get cm service-config -n prod -o yaml -> payment.timeout_ms: <absent>, MIGRATION_LOCK: <absent>

anya (infra): dry-run patch diff:
- payment.timeout_ms: <absent>
+ payment.timeout_ms: "15000"
- MIGRATION_LOCK: <absent>
+ MIGRATION_LOCK: "false"
Applying in 4m unless objections.

ben (qa): I'll monitor canary and run migration sanity and payments smoke tests. Report in 12m.

ops-bot: configmap patched in prod by anya (infra) at 3141592720 (applied).

ben (qa): canary healthy at 9m, no migration failures, checkout flows OK. Metrics within baseline.

lee (platform): rolling to 100% now.

maria (eng-release): updating release notes with the config change, KMS alias fix, PR 4951, and rollback playbook.

carla (release): HOLD cleared. creating follow-up task to add env whitelist to infra automation. Marking this deploy window as "manual-compat-patch" in the release log. :white_check_mark:
